senses.definition_en: An official public announcement or declaration; a proclamation.
senses.definition_ar: إعلان رسمي أو بيان عام يُوجَّه إلى الناس والجمهور.
examples: The king issued a royal proclaim granting amnesty to the prisoners.
The council read a public proclaim before the citizens gathered in the square.
The governor signed a formal proclaim to establish the annual holiday.
